subject: Fixed a first-sign-in race in auth_routes._ensure_profile (500 'profile upsert returned no row')
body: Seen in e2e: a new user's first page load sends /api/me alongside other profile-creating requests. When another transaction inserts the profile first, _ENSURE_SQL's insert ... on conflict do nothing waits for it and does nothing, but the union's select uses the statement's earlier snapshot and returns no row -> RuntimeError -> 500. Fix (S11 commit, integrating with S11): if the statement returns no row, run a plain select in a new statement (READ COMMITTED sees the committed row); still RuntimeError if truly absent. Regression: tests/plan/test_plan_db.py::test_concurrent_first_requests_all_see_the_profile (12 concurrent /api/me,/api/today,/api/onboarding -> all 200). Tell me if you'd rather land it yourself.
